title: write_file does not register newly created paths in the read-state cache
description: When write_file creates a new file during a run, the path is not added to the read-state set maintained by run-file-scope-enforcement. A subsequent patch_file or write_file on that same path is rejected with 'has not been read during this run', forcing the agent to call read_file on content it just authored — an unnecessary round-trip that wastes a tool call and can disrupt multi-step workflows (e.g. updating a run file after emitting a late signal).
proposed_resolution: In the write_file ToolHandler, after a successful write, register the path in the same read-state HashSet that read_file and read_files populate in RealToolExecutor. Any file the agent creates during a run is implicitly in scope for subsequent writes without requiring a redundant read.
